Quickstart

This page walks you through installing Quillmark, converting your first notebook, and publishing the result. It assumes Python 3.10 or newer, and about five minutes of your time.

Installation

Install the package from PyPI with pip, preferably inside a virtual environment:

$ pip install quillmark

If you plan to export PDFs, also install the optional extras, which pull in a headless browser. This adds roughly 150 MB to the environment, so skip it on small CI runners.

Your first conversion

Run quillmark build in a folder that contains one or more notebooks. Quillmark finds every .ipynb file, executes it in a fresh kernel, and writes a static site to _site/.

  • Cells tagged hide are executed but not shown.

  • Cells that raise an error stop the build, unless you pass --keep-going.

Note

Execution results are cached by cell content, so a second build is usually much faster than the first.

Publishing

The _site/ folder is plain HTML, which means you can host it anywhere. See Publishing for step-by-step guides for common hosts, including object storage and static site services.
